name: Ice Ice Yeti

features.name: Yeti Shake
features.description: Breaks 2–10 ice blocks to open the grid.

features.name: Ice Ice Respins
features.description: The Yeti Wild breaks blocks and awards a respin.

features.name: Expanding grid
features.description: More of the board opens as ice breaks.

review:
A grid that starts partly covered in ice. Yeti Shake can trigger on any spin, breaking two to ten blocks to open things up, and the Yeti Wild roars to break two or three blocks and award a respin where winning symbols stay put.

A neat grid-expansion idea from Nolimit's early days, with charming cartoon art. High volatility, 8,820x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
